status: registered map-only site inspection before arithmetic
question: Can the fixed gentle S-shaped route provide a clear new rolling-reference intervention and stop test?

route.reference_policy: Identical fixed global origin and clock in all arms; no reanchor or reset. Exactly zero reference velocity and acceleration in both holds. Geometry heading differs intentionally from initial robot yaw.

screens.features: All original rock/lava projected triangles, including buried triangles; clearances at least 1 m may be reported as lower bounds.

input_policy: Freeze this protocol, map-preflight source, route source, DEM and all three feature OBJ hashes before new terrain arithmetic. Preserve all failed screens. No simulator or controller execution in this stage.
decision_policy: If screens fail, retain the failed proposal and register any new site geometry before inspecting it. No route selection based on controller outcomes.
limitations: Sampled site screening is neither continuous clearance certification nor actuator feasibility. Terrain information selects the offline fixture only and never enters the live controller/contact selector.
